title: Compressing Onboard Language Models for Space Robots under a Behavioral-Fidelity Requirement
abstract: arXiv:2610.29302v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models are being explored as the interface through which space robots interpret operator commands and select among verified skills. Running them onboard calls for low-bit compression, and flight use adds requirements that generic post-training quantization leaves implicit: a fixed memory budget and storage format, a static artifact under configuration control, and behavior close to the full-precision model validated on the ground. We treat compression as a ground-segment step and study QSelect, which composes one static low-bit model from compatible AWQ, GPTQ, and AutoRound checkpoints by assigning each linear module to one quantizer family and scoring every substitution at the final next-token distribution. The default fidelity mode needs no labels or tuned thresholds and accepts a substitution only when the forward KL divergence from the BF16 reference decreases; an optional target-adapted mode adds answer likelihood on a sm

translated_title: 在行为保真度要求下压缩太空机器人的星载语言模型
translated_abstract: 语言模型正被探索作为太空机器人解释操作员指令并在已验证技能之间进行选择的接口。在星载环境下运行语言模型需要低比特压缩，而飞行应用还增加了一些通用训练后量化未能明确处理的要求：固定的内存预算与存储格式、受配置控制的静态制品，以及与在地面验证过的全精度模型相近的行为表现。我们将压缩视为地面段的一个步骤，并研究了QSelect方法，它通过将每个线性模块分配给某一个量化器家族，并在最终的下一个词元分布上对每次替换进行评分，从兼容的AWQ、GPTQ和AutoRound检查点中组合出一个静态的低比特模型。默认的保真度模式无需标签或调整的阈值，仅当与BF16参考模型相比的前向KL散度减小时才接受替换；可选的目标适配模式则增加了在小型目标数据集上的答案似然（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出QSelect方法，通过为每个线性模块从AWQ、GPTQ和AutoRound量化器中选择最优方案并以KL散度作为保真度验收标准，为太空机器人构建满足飞行硬件约束且行为接近全精度模型的静态低比特星载语言模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QSelect, which composes a static low-bit onboard language model for space robots by assigning each linear module to the best quantizer among AWQ, GPTQ, and AutoRound, accepting substitutions only when forward KL divergence decreases, thereby ensuring behavioral fidelity to the full-precision model under flight constraints.
